subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for the conflicting external fork PR, or replace/adopt it with a narrow in-repository fix for this source-reproducible issue?
rationale: The bug boundary is clear, but the only open closing-reference candidate is outside openclaw/openclaw, conflicting, and not maintainer-modifiable.

options.title: Replace or adopt the fix
options.body: Open a narrow in-repository replacement or maintainer-owned adoption, credit the external attempt, and close the external path after a viable replacement exists.

options.title: Ask for a rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase with maintainer edits enabled if possible.

options.title: Wait
options.body: Leave both items open while accepting that the known UI/TUI leak remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the fix
recommendation.body: Open a narrow in-repository replacement or maintainer-owned adoption, credit the external attempt, and close the external path after a viable replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest routing candidate from the TUI leading-stripper and current shared-helper history.
